units.role: the whole part: one 2-A synchronous step-down converter with power good (SLVSDG1C p1, p6 Figure 4), all 6 pins
identity_features: VIN 4 on the top row through a P-channel high-side FET in series (source and body on VIN, chevron out of the channel) to the switch-node dot and SW 3 (SLVSDG1C p6 Figure 4; p6 7.3.2 high-side / low-side MOSFET)

N-channel synchronous low side drops from the node (chevron into the channel), source wired to GND 2; no bootstrap pin, no catch diode, no inductor or VOUT inside the body (p6 7.1 'synchronous step-down converter')

FB 6 directly under SW (L25) into an error comparator, FB on -, 0.6V on + (p4 VFB 0.6 V); the comparator output hops the low-side source wire into a DRV block (Figure 4 Modulator + Gate Drive) that drives both gates
EN 1 runs into the DRV block (Figure 4 EN -> Control Logic) with 'H=on' / 'no float' (p3, p7 7.4.1)
PG 5 open_collector: N-channel open drain to ground with 'Z FB>=95%', 'L FB<90%', 'L EN=L' (p7 7.4.2, Table 1, p4 VPG); bold title TLV62569P, the p1 PG variant; Value TLV62569PDDCR (p16 orderable)
